title: Policy mandates stated verbatim in two policy files, and rulings policy already states
claim: Over the 84-file policy set D11.md names, 16 normalized units of >= 8 words occur verbatim in two or more files; 6 of them are live mandates outside the recorded deliberate pair and the decision history (root-cause.md/defect-root-cause.md RCA cost rule; standing-roster.md/standing-tick.md retirement constraint; steward SKILL.md/claim-files.md merge-tree check; D4.md/D4-criteria.md and D5.md/D5-criteria.md owner criteria; D11.md/RULINGS.md mechanise-first), and 1 further live RULINGS.md entry quotes text D6.md states (rulings_overlap=1), against the owner's one-mandate-one-file rule (tvofi 2026-11-15).
mechanism: Nothing measures cross-file restatement: policy_lint's `duplicates` class compares generated copies only, and RULINGS.md's rule (1) 'an entry policy already states is dropped' has no detector, so a mandate copied into a second role, brief or criteria file, or kept in RULINGS after a brief adopts it, stays until an audit reads it.

evidence.unit: duplicate units (>= 8 words) across the policy set; rulings_overlap=1
evidence.contention_note: other finder seats on the box; a count over the tree

perturbation.change: --perturb: delete, in memory, one file's copy of every duplicate unit and every corpus sentence an overlapping ruling quotes

metric_definition: normalized text_ledger D6 units of >= 8 words present in >= 2 policy files (.claude/rules folded onto source), plus live RULINGS entries a corpus file states
phenomenon_property: Each mandate is stated once, in the most authoritative policy file owning it, and pointed to elsewhere; no live RULINGS.md entry is stated by a policy file.

null_control.value: 0 DUP lines pair a .claude/rules copy with its dev/governance/rules source
null_control.note: the rules_sync-held generated pair, identical by construction, is folded and does not count, so the count is not inflated by the copies the brief excludes

proposed_fix_scope: Keep each of the 6 mandates in its owning file and replace the other copy with a pointer; drop the two RULINGS entries D6.md and D11.md state; report CLAUDE.md/orchestrator.md section 8 (recorded deliberate) and the four criteria files' shared provenance sentence to the owner; mechanise: a policy_lint class over text_ledger units refusing a new verbatim cross-file unit.
